newsitem.title: CROATIA: Australian Coca Cola Amatil opens plant in Croatia.
newsitem.headline: Australian Coca Cola Amatil opens plant in Croatia.

text.p: Croatian subsidiary of Australia's Coca Cola Amatil (CCA), a licensed bottler of the popular drink, on Sunday opened the second Coca Cola factory in Croatia, following an investment of $23 million.
The company statement faxed to Reuters said its current investment in Croatia now totalled more than $70 million, making CCA one of the largest foreign investors in the country.

The 36,000 square metre plant was built in the southern town of Solin at the Adriatic coast and is to house a production line for refillable glass bottles, a bottle blowing facility and a soft-pack line for juices.

The first Coca Cola factory opened in Zagreb in 1968. The CCA's Croatian branch has been active since early 1995, running a nation-wide production, distribution and sales of the beverage company's products.

"CCA has great confidence in the future economic prospects of Croatia, which after a period of difficulty, is on the move again," the statement quoted CCA's Managing Director Norb Cole as saying. -- Laura Lui, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
